subject: Spontaneous Application – Data Engineering Internship at Natixis
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am submitting a spontaneous application for a Data Engineering internship at Natixis in Paris. I am currently pursuing a Master in Computer Science (2024–2026) and have experience with Python and SQL from a prior development internship.

Please find attached my CV and cover letter. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to your data infrastructure initiatives.

Best regards,
John Doe
Paris
+33 6 00 00 00 00
john@example.com

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application — Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in a Data Engineering internship at Natixis in Paris as part of a spontaneous application. Contributing to data infrastructure within a banking environment is a challenge that strongly motivates me.

Currently pursuing a Master en informatique (2024–2026) at Université Exemple, I have developed skills in Python, SQL and Linux. During a development internship in 2025 at Entreprise Exemple, I created Python scripts and wrote SQL queries—expertise I am eager to apply to data engineering topics such as data processing and integration at Natixis.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you and explore how I could support your teams. Thank you for your consideration.

cv.name: John Doe
cv.headline: Étudiant en informatique — Stage en Data Engineering
cv.summary: Étudiant en informatique intéressé par l’ingénierie des données, à la recherche d’un stage en Data Engineering dans le secteur bancaire. Compétences : Python, SQL, Linux. Expérience : développement de scripts Python et écriture de requêtes SQL.
